site.name: Game Wiki
site.description: An independent game wiki with guides, characters, maps, items, and community-maintained reference material.
site.tagline: A fast, searchable, community-maintained game knowledge base.
site.legalNotice: This is an independent, unofficial fan resource. Replace this notice with the correct disclaimer for your project.

codesFaq.answer: Use an official source for your game and record the verification date in the article.

items.question: Is this an official website?
items.answer: No. This framework is intended for independent community-maintained game wikis.

items.question: How do I add content?
items.answer: Create MDX files under src/content/wiki/en and follow the frontmatter schema in src/content.config.ts.
